functionality: Stacklane Primer Tasks Phase 2 parent and student task/schedule lifecycle, including approval, recurrence, collections, lifecycle controls, restart/DST, disabled-model, and tenant-isolation behavior.
acceptance: Parent can test-authenticate, create a parent-approval brushing task, publish it, and schedule a one-off occurrence with an explicit timezone.
Parent can create bounded daily and weekly recurrence schedules with explicit timezones.
Student can use today's browser checklist, view task detail, start a task, and submit a checked state for parent approval.
Parent can reject for retry and subsequently approve the completed task.
Task, schedule, and occurrence collections expose and preserve q/filter/sort/page URL state.
Parent lifecycle controls retire a task, skip an occurrence, and cancel a schedule.
Restart and DST behavior, model-disabled flow, and two-tenant isolation are observable through public UI/API boundaries.
